title: Track and verify external reuse/citation events
context: M3 requires at least one verifiable external reuse or citation event — evidence that the reanalysis outputs are actually being used by the community. Self-reported reuse does not count; the evidence must be independently verifiable (e.g., a published paper citing the reanalysis, a dataset repository linking to the pipeline, or a confirmed downstream analysis). The tracking mechanism set up in datasheet-016 is used to capture these events.
objective: Identify, verify, and record at least one external reuse or citation event for a project reanalysis, using independently verifiable evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one external reuse or citation event is identified: e.g., a published paper citing the reanalysis, a dataset entry linking to the pipeline or manifest, or a confirmed downstream analysis by a third party not affiliated with the project.
The evidence is independently verifiable (e.g., a DOI, a URL to a repository or publication, or a public commit from a third-party org) — self-reported reuse alone does not satisfy this criterion.
The reuse/citation event is recorded in the tracking mechanism from datasheet-016 with a timestamp, evidence URL, and description.
The tracking record is licensed CC-BY-4.0 and committed to the project repo.
resources: proteomics-reanalysis-steward-018 (confirmed partner to follow up with)
output: A committed record of at least one independently verifiable external reuse or citation event for a project reanalysis; licensed CC-BY-4.0.
